title: Category & vendor leads
summary: Admins: who looks after each PO section and vendor on Fix Issues, and their daily task.

blocks.text: A **lead** looks after a part of the store on Fix Issues. An item's lead is its PO section's lead, else its vendor's lead, else the **everything-else** lead (an admin).

items: Set the leads on Setup › Category & vendor leads. A proposal is shown first; nothing is assigned until you save.
Each day at the set time (10:00 AM unless you change it), each lead gets **one Team task** with how many open items they have and a link to just theirs.
The task is due after the hours you set (6 by default). Overdue reminders work like any task.
Items closed or fixed drop off the next day's task, which replaces the day before's.
